source.quote_free_summary: Final-round ballots carry a medal threshold mark per contestant (HM, B, S, G, GH, GG), with plus and star refinements in ProAm/ProPro; couples and line are additionally ranked within a medal.

requirement: A future UCWDC profile needs its own medal-threshold ballot format and validator. NOT IMPLEMENTED: ordinal_rank@1 is a plain 1..N rank, and proficiency_rating@1/three_band@1 is a different three-band scale and is rejected; neither may be labelled UCWDC medals.
enforcement_point: Not built. NOT IMPLEMENTED; a blocker for activating the corresponding future governing-body profile. Studio/Custom behavior is unchanged.

tests.name: medal-tier values are not accepted as ordinal ranks

interpretation_notes: R-07(8). Blocker for a UCWDC profile (OD-01, OD-24). Fail-closed today: medal_group_rank@1 is not a registered ballot format and validateBallot refuses it. effective_from is taken from the companion 2026 rules version date (the Scoring Format states it is for the 2026-2028 Rules); the exact effective date is not stated in the document text.
decision_refs: R-07 (owner ratification 2026-11-23, DanceFlow policy); R-07 verification PR (docs/competition/governance/audit/R-07-VERIFICATION.md)
